versions.changelog:
- Improved skill description and usage guidelines for clarity, emphasizing local, private document search only.
- Added details on supported file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) and clarified the tool doesn’t perform web searches.
- Included a new workflow section for answering questions using local docs, with guidance on citing sources.
- Added error handling guidelines for common scenarios (no search results, missing paths).
- Updated install instructions and provided a link for more information.

DocsAgent 1.0.0 initial release:

- Enables lightning-fast hybrid (text + semantic) search over your private local PDF, DOCX, and PPTX files.
- Ensures all operations are performed 100% locally, guaranteeing complete privacy.
- Provides CLI commands to add, search, list, check status of, and stop document indexing.
- Suitable for managing and searching private documentation without data ever leaving your machine.
